The script drops blocks {2, 5, 9} instead of the required {2, 5, 8}, violating "Required result" clause 1 (remove every tensor of blocks 2, 5, 8) and clause 2 (old 9 must become 6, old 10 become 7, old 11 become 8, and old 8 should be removed). As written, old block 8 survives as new block 6, old 9 is deleted, and old 10 and 11 become 7 and 8, so the output has the right count and contiguous indices but the wrong block contents, which the bit-exact grader will reject. The checks also only assert contiguous indices and 121 tensors; they never explicitly verify that no tensor of blocks 9, 10, 11 remains as the "Required checks" section demands, though the renumbering makes that implicitly true.
